question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        p.name AS top_name,
        p.id AS current_id,
        p.name AS current_name,
        1 AS level,
        1 AS accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.top_name,
        pr.contains_id,
        p.name,
        h.level + 1,
        h.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
    JOIN packaging p ON pr.contains_id = p.id
),
leaf_totals AS (
    SELECT top_id, top_name, current_id, current_name, SUM(accumulated_qty) as total_qty
    FROM hierarchy
    WHERE current_id IN (
        SELECT p.id FROM packaging p
        WHERE p.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
          AND p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    )
    GROUP BY top_id, top_name, current_id, current_name
)
SELECT top_name AS container_name, current_name AS item_name, total_qty
FROM leaf_totals
WHERE total_qty > 500
ORDER BY container_name, item_name

{"sql": "
-- Build a recursive CTE to traverse the full hierarchy from top-level containers down to leaves
-- and compute the accumulated quantity for each path

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    -- Start from top-level containers (those not contained in anything)
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        p.name AS top_name,
        p.id AS current_id,
        p.name AS current_name,
        1 AS level,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse down through the hierarchy
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.top_name,
        pr.contains_id,
        p.name,
        h.level + 1,
        h.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
    JOIN packaging p ON pr.contains_id = p.id
)
SELECT * FROM hierarchy
ORDER BY top_id, current_id
"}
